human_decision: Accept the terms of use of sources that require it

acceptance_test: Every catalogue row has a historical result and the three current results, or a documented reason why it could not be produced, every deviation from a published value is logged with its likely cause, every current result names its locked specification and version, and a partial U.S. state reconstruction is documented as partial
human_decision: Approve the assumptions before the run

goal: Download a package of sources supporting their findings, academic and non-academic
acceptance_test: The search protocol in the research method has been carried out and logged, the package has at least one peer-reviewed study by other authors, every legally obtainable text is downloaded or has a recorded reason, and the README states the known gaps

goal: Download a package of sources setting out controversies about their findings
acceptance_test: The same protocol has been carried out and logged, every register row has an identifiable source, its argument in neutral words, its target and any reply, and every legally obtainable text is downloaded or has a recorded reason

goal: Download datasets that may support those controversies
acceptance_test: Every register row with a testable statement has a map row with its variables, coverage and years defined before acquisition, and a final state of acquired, partially_acquired or barrier_documented

goal: Publish the results on a GitHub Pages site
